title: Sullam Dār al-Salām fī Bayān Ḥikam Aḥkām Arkān al-Islām
transliterated_title: Sullam Dār al-Salām fī Bayān Ḥikam Aḥkām Arkān al-Islām (The Ladder to the Abode of Peace: An Exposition of the Wisdom Behind the Ritual Obligations of the Pillars of Islam)
genre: mystical exposition of the pillars of Islam

date.basis: MS Majlis 10196 copy date and place (Abarquh), asterisked by Melvin-Koushki as possibly transcription; terminus ad quem only.

place: Abarquh (place of the Majlis copy; Melvin-Koushki gives it as place of completion, asterisked)
summary: A mystical exposition of the doctrine and the wisdom behind the pillars of Islam, with five short chapters on the shahāda, prayer, alms, fasting and pilgrimage.
